title: Search Service Response Degradation on Node k8s-worker-12
description: Search queries taking 5,000ms instead of 80ms on worker node 12. Search container CPU is only 22%, but container is being severely throttled.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Kubernetes node CPU starvation caused by an unconstrained batch data-pipeline job scheduled on the same host (noisy neighbor).
key_evidence: Node-level metrics show host CPU at 100%
Zero application exceptions in search-service logs
distractors: Internal search-service CPU metric reports 22% (looks underutilized, leading engineers to suspect algorithmic lock)

logs.message: CFS quota throttling search-service: 88% of execution periods throttled
Heavy video transcoding batch job started on node k8s-worker-12 without cpu_limit
